name: Bestial Wrath
description: Sends you and your pet into a rage, instantly dealing 280 Physical damage to its target, and increasing all damage you both deal by 20% for 15 sec. Removes all crowd control effects from your pet.

name: Camouflage
description: You and your pet blend into the surroundings and gain stealth for 1 min. While camouflaged, you will heal for 2% of maximum health every 1 sec.

name: Intimidation
description: Commands your pet to intimidate the target stunning your target for 5 sec.

name: Binding Shot
description: Fires a magical projectile, tethering the enemy and any other enemies within 5 yds for 10 sec, stunning them for 3 sec if they move more than 5 yds from the arrow.

name: Misdirection
description: Misdirects all threat you cause to the targeted party or raid member, beginning with your next attack within 30 sec and lasting for 8 sec.

name: Counter Shot
description: Interrupts spellcasting, preventing any spell in that school from being cast for 5 sec.

name: Tranquilizing Shot
description: Removes 1 Enrage and 1 Magic effect from an enemy target.

name: Wild Thrash
description: Command your pet to thrash all enemies within 10 yds, dealing 66 Physical damage to them. Damage is increased by 200% if Wild Thrash hits 2 or more enemies.\n\nDeals reduced damage beyond 8 targets.

name: Concussive Shot
description: Dazes the target, slowing movement speed by 50% for 6 sec.

name: Kill Command
description: Give the command to kill, causing your pet to charge your target and savagely deal 72 Physical damage to the enemy.

name: Barbed Shot
description: Fire a shot that tears through your enemy, causing them to bleed for 136 damage over 12 sec. If Barbed Shot is reapplied, any remaining damage will be added to the new Barbed Shot.\n\nGenerates 20 Focus over 8 sec.

name: Black Arrow
description: You attempt to finish off a wounded target, dealing 121 Shadow damage and 140 Shadow damage over 8 sec. Only usable on enemies above 80% health or below 20% health.

name: Cobra Shot
description: A quick shot causing 110 Physical damage.\n\nReduces the cooldown of Kill Command by 1 sec.

name: Survival of the Fittest
description: Reduces all damage you and your pet take by 30% for 6 sec.

name: Roar of Sacrifice
description: Instructs your pet to protect a friendly target, reducing their damage taken by 15%, but 50% of all damage taken by that target is transferred to your pet. \n\nLasts 10 sec or until your pet's health drops below 25%.

name: Tar Trap
description: Hurls a tar trap to the target location that creates a 8 yd radius pool of tar around itself for 30 sec when the first enemy approaches. All enemies have 50% reduced movement speed while in the area of effect. Limit 1. Trap will exist for 1 min.

name: Scare Beast
description: Scares a beast, causing it to run in fear for up to 20 sec.  Damage caused may interrupt the effect.  Only one beast can be feared at a time.

name: Aspect of the Chameleon
description: The Hunter takes on the aspect of a chameleon, becoming untrackable.

name: Aspect of the Cheetah
description: Increases your movement speed by 90% for 3 sec. Upon expiring, increases your movement speed by 30% for another 9 sec.

name: Aspect of the Turtle
description: Causes all spells and attacks to miss and reduces all damage you take by 30% for 8 sec, but you cannot attack.

name: Exhilaration
description: Heals you for 30% and your pet for 100% of maximum health.

name: Titan's Thunder
description: Discharge a massive jolt of electricity from Titanstrike into all your pets and Dire Beasts, causing them to deal up to 20 Nature damage to their target every 1 sec. for 8 sec.

name: Death Chakram
description: Throw a deadly chakram at your current target that will rapidly deal 11 Shadow damage 7 times, bouncing to other targets if they are nearby. Enemies struck by Death Chakram take 10% more Physical damage from you and your pet for 10 sec.\n\nEach time the chakram deals damage, its damage is increased by 15% and you generate 3 Focus.

name: Fury of the Eagle
description: Furiously strikes all enemies in front of you, dealing 748 Physical damage over 2.7 sec. Critical strike chance increased by 50% against any target below 20% health. Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets.

name: Feign Death
description: Feign death, tricking enemies into ignoring you. Lasts up to 6 min.

name: Freezing Trap
description: Hurls a frost trap to the target location that incapacitates the first enemy that approaches for 1 min. Damage may break the effect. Limit 1. Trap will exist for 1 min.

name: Play Dead
description: Playing Dead, tricking enemies into ignoring them. Lasts up to 6 min.

name: Wake Up
description: Tell your pet to wake up.

name: Flare
description: Exposes all hidden and invisible enemies within the targeted area for 20 sec.

name: Windburst
description: Focuses the power of Wind through Thas'dorah, dealing 272 Physical damage to your target, and leaving behind a trail of wind for 5 sec that increases the movement speed of allies by 50%.

name: Feed Pet
description: Feeds your pet the selected item, instantly restoring 50% of its total health. Not usable in combat.\n\nYou may use the Beast Lore ability to identify what types of foods your pet will eat.

name: Mend Pet
description: Heals your pet for 50% of its total health over 10 sec.

name: Disengage
description: Leap backwards.

name: Ancient Zandalari Knowledge
description: Learn the ancient Zandalari secrets of taming Direhorns.

name: Arcane Shot
description: A quick shot that causes 95 Arcane damage.

name: Beast Lore
description: Gathers information about the target beast, displaying diet, abilities, specialization, whether or not the creature is tameable, and if it is exotic.

name: Call Pet 1
description: Summons your first pet to you.

name: Call Pet 2
description: Summons your second pet to you.

name: Call Pet 3
description: Summons your third pet to you.

name: Call Pet 4
description: Summons your fourth pet to you.

name: Call Pet 5
description: Summons your fifth pet to you.

name: Command Pet
description:
Commands your pet to perform its unique ability. This ability will transform based on the specialization of your active pet. 

Ferocity: Primal Rage
Tenacity: Fortitude of the Bear
Cunning: Master's Call

name: Control Pet
description: Allows you to give commands to control your pet.

name: Dismiss Pet
description: Temporarily sends this pet away. You can call it back later.

name: Eyes of the Beast
description: Take direct control of your pet and see through its eyes for 1 min.

name: Fetch
description: Command your pet to retrieve the loot from a nearby corpse within 40 yards.

name: Fireworks
description: Launch fireworks from your gun, bow or crossbow.

name: Hunter's Mark
description: Apply Hunter's Mark to the target, causing the target to always be seen and tracked by the Hunter.\n\nHunter's Mark increases the target's damage taken by 3%. Can only be applied to a target at a time.

name: Hybrid Kinship
description: Learn the secrets of taming Feathermanes.

name: Mecha-Bond Imprint Matrix
description: Allows you to tame pets in the Mechanical family.

name: Revive Pet
description: Revives your pet, returning it to life with 100% of its base health.

name: Single-Button Assistant
description: Casts damaging abilities for use in combat, rotating through them based on priority.\n\nThe global cooldown of abilities used through the Single-Button Assistant is 25% longer.

name: Steady Shot
description:
A steady shot that causes 111 Physical damage.

Usable while moving.

Generates 20 Focus.

name: Steel Trap
description: Hurls a Steel Trap to the target location that snaps shut on the first enemy that approaches, immobilizing them for 20 sec and causing them to bleed for 12 damage over 20 sec. \n\nDamage other than Steel Trap may break the immobilization effect. Trap will exist for 1 min. Limit 1.

name: Stopping Power
description: Placeholder for level 75 talented active ability.

name: Tame Beast
description: Tames a beast to be your companion. If you lose the beast's attention for any reason, the taming process will fail.\n\nYou must dismiss any active beast companions and have an empty Call Pet slot before you can begin taming a new beast. Only Beast Mastery specialized Hunters can tame Exotic Beasts.

name: Track Beasts
description: Shows the location of all nearby beasts on the minimap.

name: Track Demons
description: Shows the location of all nearby demons on the minimap.

name: Track Dragonkin
description: Shows the location of all nearby dragonkin on the minimap.

name: Track Elementals
description: Shows the location of all nearby elementals on the minimap.

name: Track Giants
description: Shows the location of all nearby giants on the minimap.

name: Track Hidden
description: Greatly increases stealth detection and shows hidden units within detection range on the minimap.

name: Track Humanoids
description: Shows the location of all nearby humanoids on the minimap.

name: Track Mechanicals
description: Shows the location of all nearby mechanicals on the minimap.

name: Track Undead
description: Shows the location of all nearby undead on the minimap.

name: Wailing Arrow
description: Fire an enchanted arrow, dealing 97 Shadow damage to your target and an additional 39 Shadow damage to all enemies within 8 yds of your target. Targets struck by a Wailing Arrow are silenced for 5 sec.

name: Wing Clip
description: Maims the target, reducing movement speed by 50% for 15 sec.

name: Chimaeral Sting
description:
Stings the target, dealing 51 Nature damage and initiating a series of venoms. Each lasts 3 sec and applies the next effect after the previous one ends.

 Scorpid Venom:
90% reduced movement speed.

 Spider Venom:
Silenced.

 Viper Venom:
20% reduced damage and healing.

name: Wild Kingdom
description: Call in help from one of your dismissed Cunning pets for 10 sec. Your current pet is dismissed to rest and heal 30% of maximum health.

name: Dire Beast: Hawk
description: Summons a hawk to circle the target area, attacking all targets within 10 yards over the next 10 sec.

name: Diamond Ice
description: Victims of Freezing Trap can no longer be damaged or healed.  Freezing Trap is now undispellable, but has a 4 sec duration.

name: Hunting Pack
description: Aspect of the Cheetah has 50% reduced cooldown and grants its effects to allies within 15 yds.

name: Interlope
description: Misdirection now causes the next 3 hostile spells cast on your target within 10 sec to be redirected to your pet, but its cooldown is increased by 15 sec.\n\nYour pet must be within 20 yards of the target for spells to be redirected.

name: Kindred Beasts
description: Command Pet's unique ability cooldown reduced by 50%, and gains additional effects.

name: Survival Tactics
description: Feign Death reduces damage taken by 90% for 2 sec.

name: The Beast Within
description: Bestial Wrath now provides immunity to Fear and Horror effects for you and your pets for 8 sec. Nearby allied pets are also inspired, increasing their attack speed by 10%.

name: Dash
description: Increases your pet's movement speed by $s1% for $d.

name: Growl
description: Your pet growls at the target, generating threat, taunting the target to attack the pet.

name: Alpha Predator
description: Kill Command now has 2 charges, and deals 15% increased damage.

name: Animal Companion
description: Your Call Pet additionally summons the pet from the bonus slot in your stable. This pet will obey your Kill Command, but cannot use pet family abilities.

name: Aspect of the Beast
description: Increases the damage of Bite, Claw, Smack and the effectiveness of your pet's unique abilities by 30%.\n\nIncreases the effectiveness of your pet's Predator's Thirst, Endurance Training, and Pathfinding passives by 50%.

name: Banshee's Mark
description: Black Arrow and Bleak Powder critical strike damage increased by 10%.

name: Barbed Scales
description: Casting Cobra Shot reduces the cooldown of Barbed Shot by 2 sec.

name: Beast Cleave
description: After you Wild Thrash, your pet's melee attacks also strike all nearby enemies for 40% of the damage for the next 8.0 sec. Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets.

name: Better Together
description: Damage dealt by your pets is increased by 2%.\n\nBarbed Shot damage increased by 10%.

name: Bleak Arrows
description: Your auto shot now deals Shadow damage, allowing it to bypass armor.\n\nAuto shot damage increased by 100%.

name: Bleak Powder
description: Black Arrow now explodes in a cloud of shadow and sulfur on impact, dealing 87 Shadow damage to all enemies within an 8 yd cone behind the target. Damage reduced beyond 8 targets.

name: Blighted Quiver
description: You fire 2 additional Black Arrows during Withering Fire's barrage.\n\nBeast Cleave and Kill Cleave damage increased by 5%.

name: Bloodshed
description: Bestial Wrath provokes your pets to tear into your target, causing your target to bleed for 504 damage over 12 sec.

name: Bloody Frenzy
description: Bestial Wrath causes your Barbed Shot to deal damage 100% faster for 10 sec.

name: Born To Be Wild
description: The cooldown of Aspect of the Cheetah, and Aspect of the Turtle are reduced by 15 sec.

name: Brutal Companion
description: Barbed Shot has a 25% chance to cause your pet to use its special attack and deal 50% bonus damage.

name: Catlike Reflexes
description: Aspect of the Cheetah's initial burst of speed is increased by 2.0 sec.

name: Cobra Senses
description: Cobra Shot Focus cost reduced by 5. Cobra Shot damage increased by 35%.

name: Cold Feet
description: When your Freezing Trap breaks, the victim's movement speed is reduced by 70% for 4 sec.

name: Combat Experience
description: Your Agility is increased by 3%.

name: Corpsecaller
description: When summoning a Dire Beast, you have a 10% chance to instead summon a Dark Hound that deals significantly increased damage.

name: Dark Chains
description: While in combat, Disengage will chain the closest target to the ground, causing them to move 40% slower until they move 8 yards away.

name: Devilsaur Tranquilizer
description: If Tranquilizing Shot removes only an Enrage effect, its cooldown is reduced by 5 sec.

name: Dire Beast
description: Damage from your bleed effects has a 4% chance of attracting a powerful wild beast that attacks your target for 8 sec.

name: Dire Cleave
description: When summoned, Dire Beasts gain Beast Cleave at 100% effectiveness for 8.0 sec.

name: Dire Command
description: Kill Command has a 20% chance to also summon a Dire Beast to attack your target for 8 sec.

name: Dire Frenzy
description: Dire Beast lasts an additional 1 sec and deals 10% increased damage.

name: Dire Summons
description: Kill Command reduces the cooldown of Howl of the Pack Leader by 1.0 sec.\n\nCobra Shot reduces the cooldown of Howl of the Pack Leader by 1.0 sec.

name: Disruptive Rounds
description: When Counter Shot interrupts a cast, gain 30 Focus.

name: Ebon Bowstring
description:
Casting Black Arrow has a 15% chance to grant Deathblow.

 Deathblow
The cooldown of Kill Shot is reset. Your next Kill Shot can be used on any target, regardless of their current health.

name: Emergency Salve
description: Feign Death and Aspect of the Turtle removes poison and disease effects from you.

name: Frenzy
description: Increases the attack speed of your active pets by 20%.

name: Fury of the Wyvern
description: Your pet's attacks increase your Wyvern's damage bonus by 1%, up to 10%.\n\nCasting Kill Command extends the duration of your Wyvern by 0.5 sec, up to 5 additional sec.

name: Go for the Throat
description: Kill Command deals increased critical strike damage equal to 100% of your critical strike chance.

name: Guardian's Hide
description: Your pet protects you at all times, reducing the damage you take by 3%. Your pet receives 100% of the damage it mitigates.

name: Guttural Roar
description: Intimidation now also stuns nearby enemies for 1.0 sec.

name: Heart of the Pack
description: Summoning a Dire Beast grants 0.50% haste for 8 sec.

name: Hogstrider
description: When your Boar deals damage, the damage of your next Cobra Shot is increased by 200%.\n\nEach additional enemy damaged by your Boar causes Cobra Shot to strike 1 additional target, up to 4.

name: Hoof and Blade
description: Hogstrider further increases the damage of Cobra Shot by 50% and it now strikes up to 3 additional targets.

name: Horsehair Tether
description: When an enemy is stunned by Binding Shot, it is dragged to Binding Shot's center.

name: Howl of the Pack Leader
description:
While in combat, every 30 sec your next Kill Command summons the aid of a Beast.

 Wyvern
A Wyvern descends from the skies, letting out a battle cry that increases the damage of you and your pets by 10% for 12 sec.

 Boar
A Boar charges through your target 1 time, dealing 504 damage to nearby enemies and an additional 420 physical damage to its primary target. Damage reduced beyond 5 targets.

 Bear
A Bear leaps into the fray, rending the flesh of your enemies, dealing 156 damage over 10 sec to up to 8 nearby enemies.

name: Hunter's Avoidance
description: Damage taken from area of effect attacks reduced by 5%.

name: Huntmaster's Call
description:
Summoning a Dire Beast 8 times sounds the Horn of Valor, summoning either Hati or Fenryr to battle.

Hati
Increases the damage of all your pets by 4%.

Fenryr
Pounces your primary target, inflicting a heavy bleed that deals 280 damage over 8 sec and grants you 4% Haste.

name: Improved Aspect of the Cheetah
description: The cooldown of Aspect of the Cheetah is reduced by 30 sec.

name: Improved Aspect of the Turtle
description: The cooldown of Aspect of the Turtle is reduced by 30 sec.

name: Improved Feign Death
description: The cooldown of Feign Death is reduced by 5 sec.

name: Improved Snaring
description: Wing Clip slows an additional 25%.\n\nConcussive Shot slows an additional 10%.

name: Improved Traps
description: The cooldown of Tar Trap and Freezing Trap is reduced by 5.0 sec.

name: Jagged Wounds
description: All bleed damage dealt by you and your pets  increased by 10%.

name: Keen Eyesight
description: Critical strike chance increased by 2%.

name: Kill Cleave
description: While Beast Cleave is active, Kill Command now also strikes nearby enemies for 40% of damage dealt. Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets.

name: Killer Cobra
description: While Bestial Wrath is active, Cobra Shot resets the cooldown on Kill Command.

name: Killer Instinct
description: Kill Command deals 10% increased damage.

name: Kindling Flare
description: Flare's radius is increased by 50%.

name: Kodo Tranquilizer
description: Tranquilizing Shot removes 1 additional Magic effect from up to 2 nearby targets.

name: Laceration
description: When your pet attacks critically strike, they cause their target to bleed for 8% of the damage dealt over 6 sec.

name: Lethal Barbs
description: Your auto shot grants 1 Focus to you and your pet.\n\nAuto shot damage increased by 25%.

name: Lone Survivor
description: The duration of Survival of the Fittest is increased by 2.0 sec.

name: Master Handler
description: Each time Barbed Shot deals damage, the cooldown of Kill Command is reduced by 0.50 sec.

name: Masterful Call
description: The duration of Master's Call is increased by 2 sec and it increases the movement speed of its target by 20%.

name: Moment of Opportunity
description: When a trap triggers, gain 30% increased movement speed for 3 sec.

name: Natural Mending
description: Exhilaration's cooldown is reduced by 30 sec.

name: Nature's Ally
description: Bestial Wrath summons an Animal Companion from your Stable to fight alongside you for 15 sec. The summoned Animal Companion obeys your Kill Command, Wild Thrash, and Stomps alongside your other pets.

name: No Hard Feelings
description: When Misdirection targets your pet, it reduces the damage they take by 50% for 5 sec.\n\nThe cooldown of Misdirection is reduced by 5 sec.

name: No Mercy
description: Your Bleed effects deal 10% increased damage.

name: Pack Mentality
description: Howl of the Pack Leader increases the damage of your Kill Command by 50%.\n\nSummoning a Beast reduces the cooldown of Barbed Shot by 4.0 sec.

name: Pack Tactics
description: Barbed Shot now instantly grants 25 Focus.\n\nPassive Focus generation increased by 75%.

name: Pact of the Hollow
description: Kill Command causes your Dark Hound to Shadow Thrash, dealing 73 Shadow damage to up to 8 nearby enemies.

name: Padded Armor
description: Survival of the Fittest gains an additional charge.

name: Pathfinding
description: Movement speed increased by 4%.

name: Piercing Fangs
description: While Bestial Wrath is active, your pet's critical damage dealt is increased by 35%.

name: Posthaste
description: Disengage also frees you from all movement impairing effects and increases your movement speed by 50% for 4 sec.

name: Precision Strikes
description: Your auto shot damage is increased by 25%.

name: Rejuvenating Wind
description: Exhilaration now also heals you for an additional 12.0% of your maximum health over 8 sec.

name: Savagery
description: Kill Command damage is increased by 10%. Barbed Shot lasts 2.0 sec longer.

name: Scent of Blood
description: Activating Bestial Wrath grants 1 charge of Barbed Shot.

name: Scout's Instincts
description: You cannot be slowed below 80% of your normal movement speed while Aspect of the Cheetah is active.

name: Serpentine Strikes
description: Cobra Shot critical damage dealt increased by 50%.\n\nWhen Cobra Shot critically strikes, it refunds 10 Focus.

name: Serrated Tips
description: You gain 2% more critical strike from critical strike sources.

name: Shadow Dagger
description: While in combat, Disengage releases a fan of shadow daggers, dealing 0 Shadow damage per second and reducing affected target's movement speed by 30% for 6 sec.

name: Sharpened Claws
description: The damage of your Bear's Rend Flesh is increased by 15%.

name: Sharpened Fangs
description: Your mastery is increased by 3%.

name: Shell Cover
description: Survival of the Fittest now summons a Turtle to aid you, further increasing its damage reduction effect by 10%.

name: Shell Wall
description: Damage taken during Aspect of the Turtle is reduced by an additional 20%.

name: Slicked Shoes
description: When Disengage removes a movement impairing effect, its cooldown is reduced by 4 sec.

name: Smoke Screen
description: Exhilaration grants you 3 sec of Survival of the Fittest.\n\nSurvival of the Fittest activates Exhilaration at 50% effectiveness.

name: Snakeskin Quiver
description: Your auto shot has a 15% chance to also fire a Cobra Shot at your target.

name: Solitary Companion
description: Your pet damage is increased by 35% and your pet is 10% larger.

name: Soul Drinker
description:
Kill Command has a 20% chance and Barbed Shot has a 50% chance to grant Deathblow.

 Deathblow
The cooldown of Kill Shot is reset. Your next Kill Shot can be used on any target, regardless of their current health.

name: Specialized Arsenal
description: Kill Command deals 10% increased damage.

name: Stampede!
description: Casting Bestial Wrath grants Howl of the Pack Leader and causes your next Kill Command to rouse the nearby wildlife into a Stampede, charging your target and dealing 468 Physical damage over 7 sec.

name: Stomp
description: When you cast Barbed Shot, your pet stomps the ground, dealing 50 Physical damage to all nearby enemies.

name: Tar-Coated Bindings
description: Binding Shot's stun duration is increased by 1 sec.

name: Territorial Instincts
description: The cooldown of Intimidation is reduced by 20 sec.

name: The Bell Tolls
description: All pet damage increased by 6%.\n\nDire Beast damage increased by 10%.

name: Thrill of the Hunt
description: Barbed Shot critical strike chance increased by 5%.\n\nCobra Shot critical strike chance increased by 15%.

name: Through the Eyes
description: Black Arrow deals 20% increased damage to enemies affected by Black Arrow's periodic damage.

name: Thundering Hooves
description: Bestial Wrath causes all active pets to Stomp at 200% effectiveness.\n\nStomp damage increased by 30%.

name: Touch of Grass
description: Your maximum health is increased by 5%.

name: Trailblazer
description: Your movement speed is increased by 30% anytime you have not attacked for 3 sec.

name: Training Expert
description: All pet damage dealt increased by 3%.

name: Trigger Finger
description: Haste increased by 2%.

name: Umbral Reach
description: Bleak Powder now applies Black Arrow's periodic effect to all enemies it damages.\n\nIf Bleak Powder damages 2 or more enemies, gain Beast Cleave if talented.

name: Unnatural Causes
description: Your damage over time effects deal 10% increased damage.\n\nThis effect is increased by 50% on targets below 20% health.

name: Ursine Fury
description: When your Bear is summoned, it is joined by 2 Dire Beasts.

name: Wailing Dead
description:
Bestial Wrath summons a Dark Hound.

For 15 sec after casting Bestial Wrath, Bestial Wrath is replaced with Wailing Arrow.

 Wailing Arrow
Fire an enchanted arrow, dealing 486 Shadow damage to your target and an additional 245 Shadow damage to all enemies within 8 yds of your target. Non-Player targets struck by a Wailing Arrow have their spellcasting interrupted and are silenced for 1 sec.

Grants Deathblow.

name: War Orders
description: Barbed Shot deals 10% increased damage, and applying Barbed Shot reduces the cooldown of Kill Command by 3.0 sec.

name: Wild Instincts
description: When your primary pet uses Stomp, apply Barbed Shot to a target hit by that Stomp. This Barbed Shot will not cause an extra Stomp.

name: Wilderness Medicine
description: Mend Pet heals for an additional 25% of your pet's health over its duration, and has a 25% chance to dispel a magic effect each time it heals your pet.

name: Wildspeaker
description: Dire Beasts will now obey your Kill Command, dealing its damage at 30% effectiveness.\n\nBestial Wrath now sends your Dire Beasts into a rage, increasing their damage dealt by 10% for 15 sec. Dire Beasts summoned during a Bestial Wrath will benefit at a reduced duration.

name: Withering Fire
description:
Bestial Wrath causes you to surrender to darkness, granting you Withering Fire for 10 sec and Deathblow.

 Withering Fire
Casting Black Arrow fires a barrage of 2 additional Black Arrows at nearby targets at 50% effectiveness, prioritizing enemies that aren't affected by Black Arrow's damage over time effect.

name: Wyvern's Gaze
description: The damage bonus from your Wyvern now lasts an additional 2.0 sec.
